messages:
eli_sales: FYI we're into a POC with NovaCloud — they tried a bulk embeddings run and hit 429s. Demo scheduled EOD tomorrow, ask to triage asap.

---

eli_sales: Customer details: Hosted trial, acct-nova_45, daily token cap 75k. They pushed a single job: 1,200 docs, avg 60 tokens -> ~72k tokens but ran a bunch in quick succession from their CI, saw intermittent 429 (retry-after ~5s).

---

maya_support: Can you paste the response headers if they've got them? Also, any client logs would help.

eli_sales: Got two samples from their integration log:

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 120
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 9
retry-after: 5
x-burst-window-seconds: 2
```

and a snippet:

```
2026-03-22T09:12:45Z ERROR limiter.go:132 route=/v1/embeddings acct=acct-nova_45 reqs_min=140 tokens=72400
2026-03-22T09:12:46Z INFO client.go:78 retrying after 5s
```

---

ravi_infra: From headers: limit 120 reqs/min for embeddings route which they hit. But they only did ~1,200 docs; depending on batch size that could be ~200 requests if batching 6 per request. Two things:
- Quick fix: raise their per-route request cap to 300 reqs/min for a 3-hour window.
- Also, the burst window shows 2s which is pretty tight. Increasing burst window to 5s allows short bursts without tripping sustained req/min counters.

paul_eng: Important: token budget is dangerously close to their 75k cap -> they probably hit token enforcement at the end of the job. We need either to provision a 24h temporary bump to 150k or suggest client-side throttling to smooth consumption.

---

maya_support: I'll spin up a short-lived support ticket and propose the combined approach: token bump to 150k for 6h + per-route cap 300/min for 4h. I'll note that this is a one-time exception for demo prep only.

zoe_oncallbot: Ticket created: TICKET-20260322-09-78 - "nova_45 embeddings 429s" Owner: maya_support. SLA: 2h.

---

eli_sales: Can we give the customer a recommended batching pattern? They're running a simple script now.

paul_eng: Recommend batches of 40-60 docs, with SDK packer 'prefer-batching' enabled if possible. Also advise to respect Retry-After and exponential backoff: start at 1s, multiplier 2, max 20s.

maya_support: Sending this message to the customer now: "We're provisioning a temporary increase: reqs/min -> 300, tokens -> 150k for next 6h. Please limit batches to 50 and implement exponential backoff honoring Retry-After headers. We'll monitor and revert changes after the window."

eli_sales: Customer replied: "Thanks, will try with 50-batch and confirm within 30m. Appreciate the quick help."

---

ravi_infra: Post-action note: whoever applies change, ensure it's scoped to acct-nova_45 and route=/v1/embeddings and that audit logs capture the override. Also add a short metric scrape to track token consumption so we can cancel earlier if they finish sooner.

paul_eng: One more thing for follow-up: recommend Dedicated or reserved capacity if they plan regular large ingests; hosted spikes will keep hitting shared limits.

eli_sales: Noted. I'll include that in the post-demo writeup. Will update thread when they confirm success or still see 429s. :thumbsup:
